info.name: Petpooja Online Ordering Menu Orders API
Push a new order into the Petpooja POS.

items.docs: Submits a new online order to the Petpooja POS. The request carries app_key, app_secret, and access_token in the body alongside an orderinfo object describing the restaurant, customer, order, order items, taxes, and discounts. The order may include a callback_url to which Petpooja posts subsequent order-status updates.
